label: TVS-672XT 6-bay NAS
description: 6-bay desktop NAS with three network ports - one 10GbE RJ45 and two 1GbE RJ45 - plus two Thunderbolt 3 ports. A PCIe Gen3 x16 slot is free for a further adapter.
notes: Onboard: 1x 10GbE (10GBASE-T copper) + 2x 1GbE RJ45. The 10G port is copper, not a cage. 2x Thunderbolt 3 ports are not Ethernet and are not modelled. PCIe Gen3 x16 slot for a 25GbE card. No OOB management port.
